links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT responses on lung cancer radiotherapy (Modified FRE, Vienna formula)
links.effect: Most responses classified as very difficult (university level) or difficult (upper secondary school) to read, due to medical language and long sentences.
links.quote: Readability analysis classified most responses as "very difficult to read" (university level) or "difficult to read" (upper secondary school), likely due to the use of medical language and long sentence structures.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT-4 responses to patient FAQs in lung cancer radiotherapy, evaluated by clinicians and real patients, but without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
